text:
Priya: Heads-up 1 11 folks in APAC asked whether statutory local holidays during the Sep 18-25 blackout will count against the new 48h carryover. Need a short blurb for the team.
Tom: quick answer pls 1 if someone already booked statutory holiday, we shouldn't penalize them?
people-ops: Short blurb to share: 'Carryover cap drops to 48h effective Jul 1. Statutory public holidays still consume PTO if booked; submit a Carryover Exception with manager sign-off for statutory conflicts and we'll prioritize approval.'
Priya: can you paste the exception form link and a manager line to copy into an email?
people-ops: Link: https://intranet.redwood/hr/forms/carryover-exception. Manager line: 'I approve a carryover exception for [NAME], reason: statutory holiday during blackout, requested carryover: [X]h. Manager: [NAME]'.
hr-bot: Policy updated in handbook (automated): https://intranet.redwood/policies/pto
Priya: perfect, I'll send that now.
